provenance.card-bg / card-fg: alert.tsx alertVariants: variant=default -> "bg-card text-card-foreground" -> globals.css --card/--card-foreground. Background is IDENTICAL for variant=destructive (still bg-card) — a real non-variation, not a missing cell.
provenance.destructive: alert.tsx variant=destructive -> "text-destructive" (root/title) and "*:data-[slot=alert-description]:text-destructive/90" (description, 90% opacity of the same color) -> globals.css --destructive
provenance.muted-fg: AlertDescription: "text-sm text-muted-foreground" -> globals.css --muted-foreground, used regardless of variant EXCEPT destructive (which overrides via the *:data-[slot] selector above)
provenance.border: alertVariants base class: "border" (no per-variant border-color override anywhere in alert.tsx) -> globals.css --border, Tailwind's undeclared default border color
provenance.structure: alert.tsx: relative grid w-full grid-cols-[0_1fr] ... has-[>svg]:grid-cols-[calc(var(--spacing)*4)_1fr] has-[>svg]:gap-x-3 [&>svg]:size-4 [&>svg]:translate-y-0.5 [&>svg]:text-current — a 2-column CSS grid (icon col collapses to 0 width with no icon), rendered here as an approximated flex layout, declared not silent
provenance.gap: has-[>svg]:gap-x-3 = 12px (icon-to-content column gap, only when an icon child is present)
provenance.font: text-sm on the root (0.875rem/1.25rem); AlertTitle adds font-medium tracking-tight (no independent size); AlertDescription adds text-sm text-muted-foreground [&_p]:leading-relaxed. shadcn has no type-scale foundation file (foundations/typography.md) — sizes read directly off these Tailwind classes.

structure.title.source: alert.tsx AlertTitle: col-start-2 line-clamp-1 min-h-4 font-medium tracking-tight

structure.actions.note: new-york-v4 canonical has no dedicated actions wrapper (arbitrary children only, no data-slot); the sibling shadcn 'radix' base variant (registry/bases/radix/ui/alert.tsx) DOES ship a dedicated data-slot="alert-action" element, used by examples/radix/alert-action.tsx — cited as supplementary evidence this is a real shadcn-family pattern, not fabricated by this registry

structure.close.note: no dedicated close part in any shadcn base variant checked (new-york-v4 or radix) — dismiss would be an ordinary composed button with no distinct data-slot hook

behavior.role.source: alert.tsx: role="alert" hardcoded, always, not a prop

prop.emphasis.note: no separate emphasis/intensity axis — variant (default/destructive) is entirely the tone axis; background never changes with it (see style.root.background)

style.root.background.note: variant=default; IDENTICAL for variant=destructive — background does not vary by tone in shadcn, unlike Salt

style.root.background@emphasis.note: no separate emphasis axis to demonstrate — see prop.emphasis

style.root.border-color.note: fixed regardless of variant — no per-tone border-color override anywhere in alertVariants, a real non-variation vs Salt

style.root.border-width.source: alertVariants base class: "border" -> Tailwind default border-width (undeclared token, per foundations/border-style.md)

style.icon.color.note: [&>svg]:text-current — no separate icon color token, inherits the root's own color (same value as style.root.color), so it follows the same tone indirection

style.root.tone@error.note: not a shadcn variant name — shadcn's two-value enum is default/destructive (see prop.tone)

style.root.tone@warning.note: not a shadcn variant name; no warning tone exists at all — the same tone-coverage gap vs Salt's four values already recorded for Button

style.root.tone@success.note: not a shadcn variant name; no success tone exists at all

style.root.tone@destructive.source: alert.tsx variant=destructive: "text-destructive" (root/title/icon, via [&>svg]:text-current) and "*:data-[slot=alert-description]:text-destructive/90" (description at 90% alpha). Background deliberately NOT included — bg-card is identical in both variants, a real non-variation

style.root.min-height.note: content-driven, no min-height token anywhere in alert.tsx — a real gap, not fabricated

style.root.font.source: text-sm on the root; family follows --font-sans's Next.js next/font resolution (foundations/typography.md flag — literal family string lives in font-loader config, not CSS)

style.root.color.note: defaults to card-fg; variant=destructive reassigns the indirection to --destructive (see style.root.tone@destructive)

style.title.font.source: AlertTitle: font-medium (500), no independent font-size (inherits the root's text-sm)

style.description.color.note: AlertDescription: text-muted-foreground — the only system with a distinct description color, separate from the title/root color. Defaults to muted-fg; variant=destructive reassigns it to destructive/90
